A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you stop by.

How do I order online?

Use any “Order pickup” button to open our Toast ordering page. Choose your food, review prices and availability, select a pickup time, and complete checkout there.

Can I dine in?

Yes! Dine-in and takeout are available at our Annapolis Road location. Come by during restaurant hours, or call (443) 433-0240 with any questions.

Is delivery available?

The linked Toast store is listed as pickup only. Use Toast for current fulfillment options, or call us if you have a question about your order.

Are there choices for kids?

Yes. The kids’ menu includes chicken nuggets and cheese, chicken, or steak quesadillas. Browse current options and prices on Toast.

What about allergies or dietary needs?

Please call (443) 433-0240 before ordering to discuss ingredients and preparation. The online menu guide does not list every ingredient or allergen.
